scope: Independent reading and lexical/pattern checks only. No C# compilation, Unity import, NUnit, controller execution, scene loading or host gameplay was run.

checks.description: Eight C# source files have balanced delimiters and preprocessor guards. This is lexical review only.
New isolated namespace and prefix are present, with no Ranch namespace/identifier leaking into code.
Catalog enforces exact current package/root GUID/Sprite GUID/fileID/manifest pin and metadata fingerprint.
Builder checks exact manifest byte SHA before PNG import and preflights every declared native PNG.

evidence.token: Current manifest bytes differ from manifest_sha256.txt.

checks.description: Builder validates actual imported Sprite/GUID/fileID and only saves its own generated catalog.
Importer restricts new add-on root and current exact manifest paths; unknown/source/inspection PNGs remain Default with no old art fallback.
Native Single/FullRect/PPU/custom ground pivot/uncompressed/no mip/no NPOT/no physics shape are explicit.
Schema rejects duplicate JSON fields and requires assets/group ground metadata.
Six exact cardinal4 network families use N1/E2/S4/W8 and no diagonal meadow selector remains.
Neighbor connection identity includes exact family + connectionGroup + logical layer + integer height plane.
All group cells are validated atomically; duplicate placement IDs, overlapping claims or host rejection invalidate the whole snapshot.
Exactly12 large +8 point group keys and declared dimensions are separate from sprite canvas size.
Groups keep one logical center and renderer; uniform world cell scale never alpha-fits or canvas-fits one tile.
Old owned sprites are hidden/cleared before deferred Destroy; replaced and empty snapshots cannot double-render.
Null/invalid new config persists attempted values and clears old owned art, rather than restoring old config.
Inactive pre-Awake configuration survives first enable; ordinary disable resets explicit layout so stale pooled art is not resurrected.
Optional posts are first2 families only and require long straight runs with straight neighbors on both sides; stable coordinate phase, no frame Random.
No collider/rigidbody/input/update/turn authority is added by Planner or Controller.
Row-down cell/group bottom-left helpers and top-left board-origin adapter are explicit and consistent.
Explicit catalog build invalidates importer row cache before reimports, including copies retaining timestamps/length.
Large/point group key is bound to art semantic family in both source preflight and loaded catalog.
JSON integer fields reject fractional/exponent literals before JsonUtility can coerce to int.

resolvedFindings.finding: Group semantic family was not bound to group key.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both current manifest builder and current catalog validate exact family/key correspondence.
